description: This file contains unit tests for error handling behaviors of the ConnectionPersistenceActor in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging package. It tests responses to create, open, close, and delete connection commands, verifying correct handling of error scenarios.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying error handling in the ConnectionPersistenceActor, including tests for create, open, close, and delete connection operations with anticipated error responses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem, pubSubMediator, and proxyActor before running the tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests are completed.

methods.name: tryCreateConnectionExpectSuccessResponseIndependentOfConnectionStatus
methods.description: Tests that creating a connection results in a success response regardless of previous connection status.

methods.name: tryOpenConnectionExpectErrorResponse
methods.description: Tests that an attempt to open a connection results in an error response.

methods.name: tryCloseConnectionExpectErrorResponse
methods.description: Tests that an attempt to close a connection results in an error response.

methods.name: tryDeleteConnectionExpectErrorResponse
methods.description: Tests that deleting a connection produces an appropriate response, including error handling.

methods.name: tryModifyConnectionExpectErrorResponse
methods.description: Helper method to test error responses for open or close connection commands.
